relevance.rationale: Proves that the first Laplacian eigenvalue of the genus-7 Hurwitz surface has sevenfold multiplicity in [1.23, 1.26], numerically identifies the corresponding 7-dimensional representation of its order-504 automorphism group, and determines a Dirichlet domain with algebraic vertex coordinates for a uniformising Fuchsian group. Adjacent to the corpus's Bring-curve chapter (highly symmetric Riemann surfaces, automorphism-group isotypic decompositions), but the corpus's curve is genus 4 with automorphism group of order 120, not a Hurwitz surface, and nothing in the tree computes Laplacian spectra of Riemann surfaces: 'Fuchsian', 'Dirichlet domain' and 'uniformiz' return one hit total across content/, in an unrelated block. The one transferable item -- the method of decomposing an eigenspace into irreps of the automorphism group -- would only become usable if the corpus ever wanted the S_5-isotypic decomposition of the Bring-curve Laplacian, which no block currently asks for.

proposedActions.rationale: No block computes or needs a Laplacian spectrum on a Riemann surface; proposing a citation here would be inflating adjacency into relevance.
